column1: # Profile `audio` rules (format: state/_shared/rules.tsv header). Profile-only kinds:
#   force <rva>                      always planned as a bind (never reused)
#   knob <rva> <symbol> <TU>         a stop callee bound to a knob stand-in (default off = the named stop)
# its callee 0x005bf670 is __stdcall with no body: the cdecl stop thunk does not link (LNK2019)
